questions.subject: ANALYTICAL_CHEMISTRY
questions.learningObjective: select an indicator for a weak acid titration
questions.stem: Sample 1301: A weak acid is titrated with a strong base and the equivalence point is near pH 8.9. Which indicator is most suitable?

options.text: An indicator that changes color near pH 7 regardless of the titration
options.misconception: assumes every titration has a neutral equivalence point

options.text: Any indicator, because the endpoint always matches equivalence exactly
options.misconception: ignores indicator error between endpoint and equivalence

options.text: An indicator with a narrow range far below the equivalence pH
options.misconception: chooses a transition outside the steep region

options.text: An indicator whose color-change interval brackets the steep portion of the curve near that equivalence pH

questions.explanation: A suitable indicator changes color over a range that lies within the sharp pH jump at equivalence. For a weak acid strong base titration that jump is basic, so a neutral indicator would change too early and introduce endpoint error.
questions.hint: Match the indicator range to the steep part of the curve.

questions.stem: Sample 1329: A weak acid is titrated with a strong base and the equivalence point is near pH 8.9. Which indicator is most suitable?

options.text: An indicator whose color-change interval brackets the steep portion of the curve near that equivalence pH
Any indicator, because the endpoint always matches equivalence exactly
options.misconception: ignores indicator error between endpoint and equivalence

options.text: An indicator that changes color near pH 7 regardless of the titration
options.misconception: assumes every titration has a neutral equivalence point

options.text: An indicator with a narrow range far below the equivalence pH
options.misconception: chooses a transition outside the steep region

questions.explanation: A suitable indicator changes color over a range that lies within the sharp pH jump at equivalence. For a weak acid strong base titration that jump is basic, so a neutral indicator would change too early and introduce endpoint error.
questions.hint: Match the indicator range to the steep part of the curve.

questions.stem: Sample 1357: A weak acid is titrated with a strong base and the equivalence point is near pH 8.4. Which indicator is most suitable?

options.text: An indicator with a narrow range far below the equivalence pH
options.misconception: chooses a transition outside the steep region

options.text: An indicator whose color-change interval brackets the steep portion of the curve near that equivalence pH
An indicator that changes color near pH 7 regardless of the titration
options.misconception: assumes every titration has a neutral equivalence point

options.text: Any indicator, because the endpoint always matches equivalence exactly
options.misconception: ignores indicator error between endpoint and equivalence

questions.explanation: A suitable indicator changes color over a range that lies within the sharp pH jump at equivalence. For a weak acid strong base titration that jump is basic, so a neutral indicator would change too early and introduce endpoint error.
questions.hint: Match the indicator range to the steep part of the curve.

questions.stem: Sample 1385: A weak acid is titrated with a strong base and the equivalence point is near pH 9.7. Which indicator is most suitable?

options.text: An indicator with a narrow range far below the equivalence pH
options.misconception: chooses a transition outside the steep region

options.text: An indicator that changes color near pH 7 regardless of the titration
options.misconception: assumes every titration has a neutral equivalence point

options.text: Any indicator, because the endpoint always matches equivalence exactly
options.misconception: ignores indicator error between endpoint and equivalence

options.text: An indicator whose color-change interval brackets the steep portion of the curve near that equivalence pH

questions.explanation: A suitable indicator changes color over a range that lies within the sharp pH jump at equivalence. For a weak acid strong base titration that jump is basic, so a neutral indicator would change too early and introduce endpoint error.
questions.hint: Match the indicator range to the steep part of the curve.
